_id.description: Unique identifier of the document. Pattern: AND-<recordNo>

recordNo.description: Business identifier of the document, readable by people and unique within the site

siteId.description: Reference to u_mes_mdm_site._id: the site the document belongs to

siteName.description: Display value of the site, copied from u_mes_mdm_site.name

workCenterName.description: Display value of workCenterId, copied from u_mes_mdm_workCenter.name

lineName.description: Display value of lineId, copied from u_mes_mdm_line.name

shiftName.description: Display value of shiftId, copied from u_mes_mdm_shift.name

andonTypeName.description: Display value of andonTypeId, copied from u_mes_ehs_andonType.name

reasonCodeName.description: Display value of reasonCodeId, copied from u_mes_eqp_reasonCode.name

raisedById.description: Reference to u_mes_mdm_user._id: user recorded for 'raised'

raisedBy.description: Display name of the user in raisedById, copied from u_mes_mdm_user.fullName

raisedAt.description: Date and time when the record was raised

acknowledgedById.description: Reference to u_mes_mdm_user._id: user recorded for 'acknowledged'

acknowledgedBy.description: Display name of the user in acknowledgedById, copied from u_mes_mdm_user.fullName

acknowledgedAt.description: Date and time when the record was acknowledged

resolvedById.description: Reference to u_mes_mdm_user._id: user recorded for 'resolved'

resolvedBy.description: Display name of the user in resolvedById, copied from u_mes_mdm_user.fullName

resolvedAt.description: Date and time when the record was resolved

downtimeEventName.description: Display value of downtimeEventId, copied from u_mes_eqp_downtimeEvent.recordNo

status.description: Primary lifecycle state of the document

schemaVersion.description: Version of this collection's document structure, starting at 1

createdAt.description: Date and time the document was created

createdById.description: Reference to u_mes_mdm_user._id: user or process that created the document

createdBy.description: Display name of the creator, copied from u_mes_mdm_user.fullName

updatedAt.description: Date and time of the most recent update

updatedById.description: Reference to u_mes_mdm_user._id: user or process that last updated the document

updatedBy.description: Display name of the last updater, copied from u_mes_mdm_user.fullName
